1. 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 12, 51) removed — would have double-counted revenue.
2. Category label variant "office supplies" normalized to "Office Supplies" (row 58).
3. Region misspellings "Suoth"→"South" (row 6) and "Eats"→"East" (row 9) normalized.
4. Row 28 Revenue was 1,055 but Quantity × Price = 105; recomputed per the rules formula.
5. 3 invalid dates (rows 24, 39, 55: "2026-14-01", "2026-02-30") set to missing — they cannot be assigned to a valid month, so those rows are excluded from the monthly totals (59 of 62 rows used).

Caveat: the 3 rows with unparseable dates are not counted in any month; if their dates can be recovered from a source system, the totals could change.
